title: Ball Resting on a Towel
question: Your approach shot comes to rest on a towel left on the course by another player. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You must play the ball as it lies on the towel.
You may remove the towel. If the ball moves as a result, replace it on its original spot without penalty.
You must take free relief and drop the ball within one club-length.
You receive a one-stroke penalty if the ball moves when the towel is removed.

explanation: A towel is a movable obstruction. You may remove it at any time. If removing the towel causes your ball to move, there is no penalty. Simply replace the ball on its original spot before making your next stroke. Rule Reference: Rule 15.2a(1).
